authorization: The explicit J16 Owner instruction authorizes bounded harmonic studies and targeted harness fixes. This contract registers one source-fix attempt per mesh after the two preserved J16-001/J16-002 test failures. Publication, release, tagging, and merge remain excluded.

preserved_prior_attempts.failure: numpy.linalg.norm was called with ord=inf on a SciPy CSR impedance before the first frequency checkpoint.

All 62 per-frequency checkpoints were written, but final summary serialization accessed a nonexistent DynamicDofReducer.fixed attribute. The stored frequency data remain unaccepted diagnostic vectors.

baseline.preservation: Both earlier contracts, source commits, runner records, per-frequency files, and PYTEST_FAILED statuses remain unchanged.

execution.retry_policy: One attempt per mesh in this new namespace. A further attempt needs a new diagnostic hypothesis or source change, contract, worktree registration, preflight, series, and ledger.

source_change: Derive fixed_dofs as total DofManager DOFs minus the reducer's free-DOF count. The preceding code used a nonexistent reducer.fixed attribute. This is summary metadata only; no solver algorithm, model, guard, threshold, load, or boundary condition changes.

boundary_conditions: RY=0 on bottom and top edges
RX=0 on left and right edges
model.complex_convention: (K + i*omega*C - omega^2*M) U = F with exp(+i*omega*t)

inputs.mesh_only_variable: MITC4 quadrilaterals per plan edge; all other geometry, material, load, support, damping, measurement, and frequency inputs are fixed.
inputs.observable: Complex center UZ at the physical point (5,5,0) m, which is a node for each even mesh.

reference.independence: Odd/odd Navier series through index 51, using no QF assembled matrices.
reference.theory: Thin Kirchhoff-Love reference compared descriptively to finite-mesh MITC4/Reissner-Mindlin.
reference.comparison_limit: Formulation and finite-thickness differences remain; no mechanical correlation threshold is set.

methods_and_indicators.route: For each frequency, solve the QF-assembled reduced impedance with SciPy spsolve and separately call the QF direct_frequency route. Preserve exact route status; never promote unguarded vectors.
methods_and_indicators.load_check: Record assembled load resultant, direct translational nodal-force sums, and differences from the flat-area analytical resultant (0,0,-10000) N.
methods_and_indicators.residuals: Record relative L2 residual and sparse-compatible eta_inf = ||Ax-b||_inf/(||A||_inf||x||_inf+||b||_inf). The production guard remains at the historical 1e-7.
frequency_indicators: Smallest generalized frequency from that mesh's QF K/M, distinguished from damped response peak.
Dense sampled peak and local quadratic estimate on log amplitude, reported separately.
Amplitude, phase, and complex UZ discrepancy at each common-grid point.
Complex error normalized by the Navier peak over the common dense grid; phase omitted below 5 percent of that scale.
methods_and_indicators.completion_checks: Each mesh writes 62 final JSON/NPZ frequency records, finite raw vectors, summary, CSV, figures, and SHA-256 manifest. The test rejects HARNESS_ERROR and checks assembled/direct load sums within 1e-8 N. These checks are not a mechanical PASS.

resources.estimate: J15's 8x8, 152-frequency run took 42.849 s. J16 has 62 points but larger meshes; 30 minutes and 2 GiB soft RSS per mesh are conservative estimates, not measurements.

artifacts_to_preserve: Per-frequency atomic JSON/NPZ checkpoints with raw solution before the QF route and final route status afterward.
Per-mesh site_data.json, CSV, setup figure, amplitude/phase plot, peak deformation image, and artifact manifest.
Exact-node preflight, separate attempt ledger, runner/source fingerprints, environment, logs, and sampled resource observations.
J16-001 and J16-002 failures and all J14/J15 historical statuses unchanged.
